name: Encrypted Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek sends new rogues to Rwag with a coded message. The summons leads them into the Den, where rogue training is bound to the Shattered Hand.

sections.title: A Coded Summons
sections.body: Gornek gives the Encrypted Tablet to initiates who prove their mettle against the local wildlife. Its message is written in cipher, a test and safeguard for those trained in stealth, poison, and subterfuge. The summons sends each recruit into the Den to meet Rwag, trainer of the Horde’s rogues, thieves, and cutpurses.

sections.title: The Shadow of the Hand
sections.body: Inside the Den, Rwag trains new rogues as an agent aligned with the Shattered Hand. He says the guild will not dictate every breath, yet the Hand holds him to account if an apprentice fails to perform. The fledgling Horde is surrounded by foes, so it depends on silent scouts and agile cutpurses to gather intelligence and strike from the shadows.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Tablet?
faq.answer: The Encrypted Tablet summons novice rogues from the Valley of Trials to meet their trainer, Rwag, inside the Den.

faq.q: Who delivers the tablet to the player?
faq.answer: Gornek, who oversees trials in the valley, gives you the tablet after you prove yourself in your first combat trial by killing Mottled Boars.
Rwag can be found deep inside the Den, the cavern complex along the Valley of Trials’ northern cliffside.

faq.q: What is 'the Hand' mentioned by Rwag?
faq.answer: Rwag means the Shattered Hand, a covert network and guild of assassins, spies, and rogues serving Warchief Thrall’s Horde.

faq.q: Why is the tablet written in an encrypted cipher?
faq.answer: The cipher hides sensitive rogue business and handlers’ identities from prying eyes. It also tests whether an initiate can handle discreet messages.

faq.q: Can any class undertake this quest?
faq.answer: No. Only troll rogues beginning their journey in the Valley of Trials receive the Encrypted Tablet.

angles.text: As a rogue, you meet your first mentor, Rwag, through the tablet and encounter the Shattered Hand’s reach in Durotar.
As an orc, you come from a culture that honors open battlefield combat. Orc rogues serve the modern Horde as scouts and infiltrators.
As a troll, you bring jungle tracking instincts to the bladecraft taught by mentors in the Den. This gives you quiet utility among your orc allies.
